howTo: Optional override only. The engine already scores each league from Sportradar finished matches and from picks it has settled. Leave leagues empty. Add a band only to force an extra exclude or penalise. A key is the tournament name, or "country | tournament". Each band is {"market":"over25","min":1.40,"max":1.49,"action":"exclude"}. action exclude drops the pick. action penalise caps a published grade at 90%. market "*" means every market. A file at ENGINE_DATA_DIR/league-risk.json or LEAGUE_RISK_PATH replaces this one. It cannot force a pick through a block the results already produced.
